column1: eyebrow|n.|眉毛|She raised one eyebrow when she heard the news.|她聽到這個消息時揚起一邊的眉毛。|He has thick black eyebrows.|他有濃密的黑眉毛。
eyelash|n.|睫毛|She has long, curly eyelashes.|她有長長捲捲的睫毛。|An eyelash fell into my eye.|我的眼睛裡掉進了一根睫毛。
eyelid|n.|眼瞼，眼皮|My eyelids felt heavy after the long drive.|長途開車後，我的眼皮感覺很沉重。|The baby closed her eyelids and fell asleep.|寶寶闔上眼皮睡著了。
nose|n.|鼻子|He has a runny nose because of the cold.|他因為感冒而流鼻水。|Dogs have a very good sense of smell in their noses.|狗的鼻子嗅覺非常靈敏。
cheek|n.|臉頰|She kissed her grandmother on the cheek.|她親了親奶奶的臉頰。|His cheeks turned red in the cold wind.|他的臉頰在寒風中凍得發紅。
tooth|n.|牙齒|My son lost his first tooth yesterday.|我兒子昨天掉了第一顆牙。|You should see a dentist if you have a bad tooth.|如果有一顆牙不舒服，你應該去看牙醫。
fist|n.|拳頭|He clenched his fist in anger.|他氣得握緊了拳頭。|The boxer raised his fist in victory.|拳擊手舉起拳頭慶祝勝利。
entree|n.|主菜|For my entree, I'll have the grilled salmon.|我的主菜要點烤鮭魚。|The entree comes with soup and a small salad.|主菜附有湯和一份小沙拉。
napkin|n.|餐巾|Could I have an extra napkin, please?|可以再給我一張餐巾嗎？|He put the napkin on his lap before eating.|他吃飯前先把餐巾鋪在腿上。
spoon|n.|湯匙|Use a spoon to eat the soup.|請用湯匙喝湯。|She stirred her tea with a small spoon.|她用小湯匙攪拌她的茶。
chopsticks|n.|筷子|Can you use chopsticks to eat noodles?|你會用筷子吃麵嗎？|The restaurant gives you a pair of chopsticks and a spoon.|這家餐廳會給你一雙筷子和一支湯匙。
mug|n.|馬克杯|He poured hot coffee into his favorite mug.|他把熱咖啡倒進自己最愛的馬克杯。|I left my mug on the kitchen table.|我把馬克杯忘在廚房的桌上了。
straw|n.|吸管|Do you want a straw with your drink?|你的飲料要吸管嗎？|The child sipped orange juice through a straw.|小孩用吸管啜飲柳橙汁。
takeout|n.|外帶餐點|Let's order takeout tonight instead of cooking.|今晚我們別煮了，叫外帶吧。|Is this for here or takeout?|這是內用還是外帶？
bunk|n.|雙層床的床鋪|My brother sleeps in the top bunk.|我弟弟睡在雙層床的上鋪。|The kids were excited to share a bunk bed at camp.|孩子們很興奮能在營地裡睡雙層床。
mattress|n.|床墊|This mattress is too soft for my back.|這張床墊對我的背來說太軟了。|We bought a new mattress last weekend.|我們上週末買了一張新床墊。
quilt|n.|被子，棉被|Grandma made this quilt by hand.|奶奶親手縫了這條被子。|Pull the quilt up if you feel cold.|如果覺得冷，就把被子拉上來。
nightstand|n.|床頭櫃|She put her glasses on the nightstand.|她把眼鏡放在床頭櫃上。|There is a small lamp on the nightstand.|床頭櫃上有一盞小燈。
blinds|n.|百葉窗|Please close the blinds; the sun is too bright.|請把百葉窗拉下來，陽光太刺眼了。|The blinds in my room are broken.|我房間的百葉窗壞了。
crib|n.|嬰兒床|The baby is sleeping in her crib.|寶寶正睡在她的嬰兒床裡。|We need to buy a crib before the baby arrives.|寶寶出生前，我們得先買一張嬰兒床。
hanger|n.|衣架|Please put your coat on a hanger.|請把你的外套掛在衣架上。|I need more hangers for my closet.|我的衣櫥需要更多衣架。
wok|n.|炒菜鍋，中式炒鍋|He stir-fried the vegetables in a hot wok.|他在熱炒鍋裡翻炒蔬菜。|A wok is perfect for making fried rice.|炒鍋最適合做炒飯。
skillet|n.|平底煎鍋|She cooked the eggs in a cast-iron skillet.|她用鑄鐵平底鍋煎蛋。|Heat the skillet over medium heat.|用中火加熱平底鍋。
spatula|n.|鍋鏟，刮刀|Use a spatula to flip the pancakes.|用鍋鏟把鬆餅翻面。|He scraped the bowl clean with a rubber spatula.|他用橡膠刮刀把碗刮乾淨。
ladle|n.|長柄勺|She served the soup with a large ladle.|她用一支大長柄勺盛湯。|Hang the ladle on the hook next to the stove.|把長柄勺掛在爐子旁邊的掛鉤上。
grater|n.|刨絲器|Use a grater to shred the cheese.|用刨絲器把起司刨成絲。|She bought a new grater for carrots.|她買了一個新的紅蘿蔔刨絲器。
peeler|n.|削皮器|A peeler makes it easy to remove potato skin.|有了削皮器，要削馬鈴薯皮很容易。|Be careful when you use the peeler.|使用削皮器時要小心。
colander|n.|濾碗，瀝水籃|Pour the pasta into a colander to drain the water.|把義大利麵倒進瀝水籃裡濾掉水。|She washed the grapes in a colander.|她把葡萄放在濾碗裡清洗。
strainer|n.|濾網|Pour the tea through a strainer.|把茶倒過濾網。|He used a strainer to catch the tea leaves.|他用濾網擋住茶葉。
toaster|n.|烤麵包機|Put two slices of bread in the toaster.|把兩片吐司放進烤麵包機。|The toaster popped up and the toast was ready.|烤麵包機彈了起來，吐司烤好了。
teapot|n.|茶壺|She poured hot water into the teapot.|她把熱水倒進茶壺。|My grandmother has a beautiful blue teapot.|我奶奶有一個漂亮的藍色茶壺。
jar|n.|罐子，廣口瓶|There is a jar of honey on the shelf.|架子上有一罐蜂蜜。|He opened the jar of pickles.|他打開那罐醃黃瓜。
tongs|n.|夾子，食物夾|Use tongs to pick up the hot bread.|用夾子夾起熱麵包。|He turned the steaks with a pair of tongs.|他用夾子把牛排翻面。
apron|n.|圍裙|The cook put on an apron before cooking.|廚師煮菜前先繫上圍裙。|My apron is covered with flour.|我的圍裙沾滿了麵粉。
sponge|n.|海綿，菜瓜布|Wipe the table with a wet sponge.|用濕海綿擦桌子。|I need a new sponge to wash the dishes.|我需要一塊新的海綿來洗碗。
pantry|n.|食品儲藏室|We keep rice and canned food in the pantry.|我們把米和罐頭放在食品儲藏室。|The pantry is almost empty, so let's go shopping.|儲藏室快空了，我們去買東西吧。
